collab.title: Collaboration requests
collab.applyCta: Apply to teach at a center
collab.acceptDesc: Accepting creates the affiliation, the class, and its full session schedule in one step.
collab.acceptedToast: Accepted — class and schedule created. Set prices so students can subscribe.
collab.missingFields: Pick the other party, subject, grade, at least one day, and a start date
collab.subject: Subject
collab.noHallsAtCenter: This center has no halls listed yet
collab.splitByPlatform: The revenue split for this hall is set by the platform.
collab.shareByPlatform: The center's share is set by the platform. Neither the teacher nor the center enters an amount.
collab.methodPercentHint: The hall takes a fixed percentage of each lesson. The percentages are set by the platform.
collab.methodPerStudentHint: The hall's share is calculated per student who actually attends each session. No fixed price — it depends on attendance.
collab.perStudentNote: The hall's share is calculated per attending student and set by the platform. There is no fixed hall price.
collab.perStudentRatePercent: {value}% of the lesson price per attending student
collab.perStudentRateNotePercent: This hall takes {value}% of the lesson price for every attending student. Whatever is left after the platform's share is yours, and it is fixed on the class when it is created.
collab.perStudentRateNoteFlat: This hall takes {value} for every attending student. Whatever is left after the platform's share is yours, and it is fixed on the class when it is created.
collab.teacherPicksAtAccept: This hall offers both pricing methods — the teacher chooses one when accepting.
collab.chooseMethodDesc: The hall {hall} offers both pricing methods. Pick how the hall's share is calculated for your class — all rates are set by the platform.

checkin.title: Counter check-in
checkin.description: Search a student by code, phone, or name — then pick the session.
checkin.noMatches: No students found — create a walk-in below
checkin.crossCenterNote: Already in the system at {center} — they can keep it or switch after this session (they'll get a prompt).
checkin.noSessionPriceHint: No per-session price — the center owner sets it on the Classes screen to enable collection here
checkin.counterDone: Counter check-in done — door check-in still needed
checkin.needsPayment: No coverage — collect the per-session payment first
checkin.walkInFailed: Could not create the walk-in student
checkin.waFailed: WhatsApp delivery failed — see the back-office log
checkin.guardianEmailMissing: No guardian email — hand the link over in person
checkin.guardianEmailMissingTitle: A guardian email is still needed
checkin.guardianEmailMissingBody: {name} is under 18 and has no guardian email on file, so we did not email the student. Give the guardian the link below, and add their email when you have it. Messaging with teachers and staff stays off until then — classes and payments are unaffected.
checkin.guardianContactHint: Email is what we send the account link to and what enables messaging with teachers. If the guardian has no email, take their phone — we keep it on record.
checkin.needsPaymentBody: {course} is not covered for this student. Collect the session fee in cash now and attendance is recorded in the same step.
checkin.armedAnnounce: Waiting for confirmation: take {price} in cash and check the student in. Press Escape to cancel.
checkin.cashFailed: The payment was not recorded — nothing was charged. Try again.
checkin.paidNotCheckedIn: The cash was collected and written to the ledger, but attendance was not marked. Do NOT collect again — just press “Check in”.
checkin.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR square on the card.
checkin.scanDenied: The camera could not be opened. Type the code instead.

counter.title: Counter board
counter.description: Pick the teacher — today's lessons and the roster come up ready to check in.
counter.noSessionsToday: This teacher has no lessons today
counter.noStudentMatch: No student by that name in this lesson
counter.noStudentMatchHint: Press Search to look across all students by code or phone.
counter.loadFailed: Could not load this teacher's lessons
counter.noLessonHint: Pick a teacher and a lesson above. Student search and walk-in registration work either way.

door.title: Door check-in
door.description: Confirm counter-checked students at the classroom door.
door.handedOff: Card received — code {code}. Pick the lesson to confirm attendance.
door.loadFailed: Could not load the session roster
door.emptyRoster: Nobody has passed the counter yet
door.noCounterHint: Cannot be confirmed at the door before passing the counter.
door.counterFirst: Student has not been checked in at the counter — door check-in requires the counter first
door.counterOnlyNotice: Your attendance mode is “counter only” — the counter check-in alone marks attendance; this screen is used in “counter + door” mode.
door.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR square — it confirms as soon as it reads.
door.scanDenied: The camera could not be opened. Type the code instead.
door.offlineNotOnList: That student is not on this lesson's saved list. Finding them needs a connection.

ledger.loadFailedHint: Check the connection and try again. Nothing was written.
ledger.twoStepHint: Two steps: the first press arms the button, the second commits.
ledger.armedHint: The next press is final — the entry is written in your name and cannot be undone.
ledger.armedAnnounce: Button armed. The next press is final. Press Escape to cancel.

searchTruncated: Keep typing to narrow this down
searchMasked: Name hidden — this student is not on your center's roster

viewAs.title: Viewing as {name}
viewAs.subtitle: You are inside this account, opened by {actor}. Everything you do here — money included — is recorded against the real account.

emailCardSubtitle: The address you sign in with, and where password resets and receipts are sent.
emailUnverified: This address has not been confirmed yet.
emailPasswordWhy: Your password confirms it is you — whoever holds this address can reset the account.
emailChanged: Email updated. Keep signing in with the new address.
emailTaken: Another account already uses this email.
emailIsGuardians: This is your guardian's email. Your own login email has to be different.
guardianCardSubtitle: Where account and safety notices about the student are sent. Correct it here whenever it is wrong.
guardianCardEmailHint: A changed address counts as unconfirmed again until someone opens the link we send it.
guardianCardPhoneHint: Kept for the record. The safety notices go to the email.
guardianCardNeedsOne: Enter a guardian email or phone number.
academicSubtitle: What you chose when you first signed up. It decides which subjects you see — fix it here if it is wrong.
